fields.Name: Skip ICF - Members by Region and Country
fields.Description: Member geography from MoreCheese: Member Profiles (Region, CountryName) with drill-down. Replaces AssociationDB "Chapter Membership Distribution" — ICF has regions/countries, not chapters.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me a chart of how many members we have in each region, and let me click a region to see a breakdown by country. Then let me click a country to see who the members are. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of member counts by region
Regions are NA, EU and RoW with NA the largest (about 1,267 of about 2,109 members)
Clicking a region shows member counts by country within that region (United States is the largest country, about 1,073)
Clicking a country shows a table of members in that country
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
